## OWNER verified Phase C hosted CI failure — package the real V2 suite into isolated HTTP image (2026-11-12)

**This is a newly discovered real CI integration blocker, distinct from the archived V1 RED and distinct from docs-only PR #52.** Do not misreport the 4 jobs as green.

Owner directly read hosted [run 43186042273](https://github.com/gloweaseco-leo/VRAE/actions/runs/43186042273), exact QA HEAD at execution `b74318110ba14a23e6db6af393d4f8226ed33443` and previous accepted main `61b88eb31d1dec668e7e05495b88fe2d8a5b25fe`:
- Python3.11 **SUCCESS**, Python3.13 **SUCCESS**, isolated-browser **SUCCESS**.
- **isolated-http FAILURE**: real job [131073329434](https://github.com/gloweaseco-leo/VRAE/actions/runs/43186042273/job/131073329434), raw log: `ERROR collecting tests/reporting/test_ra3c_owner_adjudicated_v2.py` → `FileNotFoundError: /work/docs/03-engineering/ra3c-independent-qa/phase-c-main-integration/collection_contract.py`, exit code 2 inside isolated lab. Not a finding-quality/product deficiency and not a runner infrastructure outage.
- **Reproduced root from exact Git objects:** `infra/ra1a/Dockerfile` copies `vrae`, `contracts`, `industry-packs`, `tests`, `scripts` but **does not copy `docs`**; `.dockerignore` explicitly excludes `docs`. The new default-discovered V2 shim in `tests/reporting/test_ra3c_owner_adjudicated_v2.py` imports its frozen `collection_contract.py` and original V2 evidence from `docs`; the image cannot resolve this file.

**Owner decision / narrowly authorized remediation (Codex-1 on PR #48 only):**
1. Fix the **actual required QA fixture/module packaging in the isolated lab**, not the test result. The frozen V1 and V2 test source and all 64+54 oracles remain unchanged; do **not** skip/xfail/deselect the 118 V2 cases in isolated-http or change `VRAE_ISOLATED_LAB` to bypass discovery.
2. Preferred solution: a small, explicit QA evidence/fixture allowlist for Docker context and a minimal explicit Dockerfile COPY of the *immutable required* V2 collection contract, source/provenance, fixture and browser-receipt data. Keep unrelated docs out of the image; retain network-none, read-only, privilege/security and existing package/test commands **exactly**. If that cannot be done safely, instead use an independent, pinned test-local bundle under `tests/reporting/**` with original canonical SHA verification. Never fabricate a pass, copy unverified producer results or rewrite source bytes.
3. **Conditional narrow file authorization:** only if essential to the trusted test packaging, Codex-1 may change `infra/ra1a/Dockerfile` and `.dockerignore` in addition to previously permitted QA tests, minimal `pyproject.toml` collection settings and QA-only docs. This **does not** authorize changing `.github/workflows/**`, `infra/ra1a/entrypoint.sh`, `vrae/**`, frozen schemas, source security/Guard, existing isolation tests, other Dockerfiles or any dependency version. Record an exact per-line minimal diff and security impact; no broad `COPY . .` or open-ended `!docs/**` inclusion.
4. **Reproduce the actual Docker build + network-none execution** (including V2 118 collected and real PASS + existing isolation tests) before claiming resolution. Preserve original run 43186042273 FAIL/JUnit/logs. Then **normal merge latest main** (now exact `696d4ae695041f0eeefa56d22039682a989380b2` after Owner accepted docs-only PR #52), re-run **fresh four actual hosted jobs on final QA HEAD + this main**, capture checkout parents and all original job logs. Final 4/4 must genuinely be SUCCESS. Don't claim old successful 3 jobs establish a 4/4 PASS on new SHA.
5. If the minimum image package must exceed frozen source/fixture allowlist, or changes isolation/security properties, **STOP** and submit a scope/risk report rather than weaken protection.

**No PR #48 merge or RA3D production GO before final Owner independent review.** Existing V1 historical 11/53 RED stays separately executable and disclosed; V2 64+54 must genuinely pass in default current test discovery. Human Gold 0/26 and customer share NO-GO unchanged.

Owner status: `PR48_PHASEC_ISOLATED_HTTP_PACKAGING_FAIL / MINIMAL_REPAIR_AUTHORIZED / FINAL_4_CI_NO_GO`.
